card.fact_statement: The Interim government formed after the 2024 non-cooperation movement was led by Muhammad Yunus.
card.source_span: the military and President Mohammed Shahabuddin announced the formation of an Interim government led by Muhammad Yunus.

card.fact_statement: Asif Nazrul served as the law, justice and parliamentary affairs adviser to the interim government.
card.source_span: However, the law, justice and parliamentary affairs adviser to the government, Asif Nazrul, said that the incumbent would "remain in power as long as necessary".
